title: CP Plus vs Hikvision CCTV: Which Brand Should You Choose?
excerpt: Detailed comparison between CP Plus and Hikvision cameras. Pros, cons, price comparison, and which is best for homes vs businesses in India.
author: Eye Smart Security Systems

faqs.q: Which brand is better: CP Plus or Hikvision?
faqs.a: Both are excellent. CP Plus excels in India-specific support and value pricing (₹3,000-6,000 per camera). Hikvision offers superior AI analytics and 4K quality but costs more (₹5,000-10,000). For Indian customers, CP Plus edges out for reliable support in local language.

faqs.q: Are there data privacy concerns with Hikvision?
faqs.a: Hikvision is a Chinese company, which concerns some users. However, their Indian data centers meet GDPR standards. CP Plus is Indian (owned by KPITECH), so locally stored data. Both comply with Indian law. Choose based on your comfort level.

faqs.q: Do both brands support remote monitoring from mobile?
faqs.a: Yes. CP Plus uses iVMS-4200, Hikvision uses Hik-Connect. Both apps are reliable for remote access. iVMS is simpler; Hik-Connect offers more advanced features like AI alerts.

faqs.q: Which brand has better warranty support in Delhi NCR?
faqs.a: Both have service centers in Noida/Delhi. CP Plus has slightly better response time (24-48 hours). Hikvision is faster in metro areas but slower outside. Eye Smart provides with 24/7 support regardless.

faqs.q: Can I mix CP Plus and Hikvision cameras?
faqs.a: Technically possible but not recommended. Each brand's NVR/DVR works best with their own cameras. Mixed systems have compatibility issues. For your first installation, stick with one brand.

content:
CP Plus vs Hikvision: Which CCTV Brand Should You Buy?

If you're shopping for CCTV cameras in India, you've probably come across CP Plus and Hikvision. Both are excellent brands, and choosing between them confuses many customers.

This comparison is based on our experience installing 1000+ CP Plus and 1000+ Hikvision systems across Delhi NCR, Noida, and Ghaziabad.

Company Background

CP Plus (Color Packaging + Security)

  • Headquarters: Bengaluru, India (Indian company)
  • Founded: 2008
  • Parent Company: KPITTECH Limited
  • Products: CCTV, access control, alarm systems
  • Market Position: #2 in India (by volume)

Hikvision

  • Headquarters: Hangzhou, China
  • Founded: 2004
  • Products: CCTV, face recognition, thermal imaging
  • Market Position: #1 globally, #1 in India (by value)

Price Comparison

Product TypeCP PlusHikvisionPrice Difference
2MP Dome Camera₹3,000 - ₹4,000₹4,500 - ₹6,000Hikvision 30-50% costlier
4MP Camera₹5,000 - ₹6,500₹6,500 - ₹9,000Hikvision 20-40% costlier
4-Channel DVR₹5,500 - ₹8,000₹8,000 - ₹12,000Hikvision 30-60% costlier
4-Channel PoE NVR₹9,000 - ₹12,000₹12,000 - ₹18,000Hikvision 25-50% costlier

Summary: Hikvision is 20-50% more expensive. CP Plus offers better value for budget-conscious customers. For an 8-camera system: CP Plus ₹50,000-60,000; Hikvision ₹75,000-90,000.

Image Quality Comparison

CP Plus

  • Resolution: 2MP to 5MP available (up to 5 megapixel)
  • Night Vision: Good IR range (up to 20-30 meters)
  • Day Performance: Clear, good color reproduction
  • Video Compression: H.264, H.265 (latest models)
  • Verdict: Excellent for most security needs. Facial recognition works up to 5-6 meters.

Hikvision

  • Resolution: 2MP to 8MP+ (up to 8K in some premium models)
  • Night Vision: Excellent IR (up to 50+ meters in some models)
  • Day Performance: Superior color accuracy, slightly better dynamic range
  • Video Compression: H.264, H.265, AVC, better bitrate optimization
  • Verdict: Professional-grade. Facial recognition up to 10-15 meters. Best for critical applications.

Real-World Impact: For typical home/office use, CP Plus image quality is sufficient. For retail stores requiring transaction verification or industrial sites needing long-range monitoring, Hikvision's superior quality justifies the cost.

Feature Comparison

AI & Analytics

  • CP Plus: Basic motion detection, intrusion detection. AI is limited to newer models.
  • Hikvision: Advanced: facial recognition, crowd counting, loitering detection, heat mapping.
  • Winner: Hikvision (if you need AI features)

Mobile App & Remote Access

  • CP Plus: iVMS-4200 (simple, user-friendly, works on poor internet)
  • Hikvision: Hik-Connect (feature-rich, cloud-based, requires better internet)
  • Winner: Tie (both excellent; choose based on preference)

Ease of Setup

  • CP Plus: Simpler configuration, better for non-technical users
  • Hikvision: More options, steeper learning curve for configuration
  • Winner: CP Plus

Build Quality

  • CP Plus: Durable Indian-manufactured cameras, good for 5-7 years
  • Hikvision: Premium build, lasts 7-10+ years
  • Winner: Hikvision (slightly better manufacturing standards)

Warranty & Support

  • CP Plus: 1 year (India-wide), service centers in major cities, local support in Hindi/regional languages
  • Hikvision: 3-5 years (premium packages), strong warranty but slower support outside metros
  • Winner: Hikvision (better warranty); CP Plus (better local support)

Specific Product Recommendations

Best for Home Security (Apartments)

CP Plus Choice: CP Plus CP-UCR-2.8 (2MP dome) - ₹3,200
Hikvision Choice: Hikvision DS-2CD1123G0-I (2MP) - ₹5,500
Winner: CP Plus (saves ₹2,300 for same performance)

Best for Retail Shop

CP Plus Choice: CP Plus IPC-4K14ZS-UMS (4MP, zoom) - ₹6,500
Hikvision Choice: Hikvision DS-2CD2743G0-IZS (4MP, zoom) - ₹9,000
Winner: Hikvision (superior zoom and focus for transaction capture)

Best Value 8-Camera Hybrid Kit

CP Plus: 4x 2MP + 4x 5MP = ₹45,000-55,000
Hikvision: 4x 2MP + 4x 4MP = ₹70,000-85,000
Winner: CP Plus (₹20,000+ savings)

Best for Industrial/Premium Setup

Hikvision with AI: 8x 8MP + AcuSense NVR = ₹120,000-180,000
CP Plus Alternative: 8x 5MP + standard NVR = ₹60,000-80,000
Winner: Depends on your need for AI (Hikvision) vs cost (CP Plus)

Pros & Cons

CP Plus Pros

  • ✅ 30-50% cheaper than Hikvision
  • ✅ Made in India (supports local manufacturing)
  • ✅ Good warranty and local service support
  • ✅ Simpler setup for non-technical users
  • ✅ Reliable for 5-7 years with maintenance

CP Plus Cons

  • ❌ Limited AI features in budget models
  • ❌ Slightly lower build quality vs Hikvision
  • ❌ Lower warranty period (1 year standard)
  • ❌ May not last as long as Hikvision

Hikvision Pros

  • ✅ Superior image quality (4K/8K options)
  • ✅ Advanced AI analytics (facial recognition, etc.)
  • ✅ Better build quality and durability
  • ✅ Longer warranty (3-5 years)
  • ✅ Better for professional use cases

Hikvision Cons

  • ❌ 30-50% more expensive than CP Plus
  • ❌ Slower support outside metro areas
  • ❌ Complex setup for non-technical users
  • ❌ Data privacy concerns (Chinese company, though compliant with Indian law)

Security & Privacy Concerns

CP Plus (Indian Company)

  • Data stored locally (India)
  • No international data transfer concerns
  • Complies with Indian privacy laws
  • Supports "Make in India" initiative

Hikvision (Chinese Company)

  • Data can be stored in Indian data centers or China
  • GDPR and Indian law compliant
  • Some government organizations restrict Hikvision for sensitive projects
  • Generally safe for residential/commercial use

Recommendation: If data privacy is your top concern, choose CP Plus. If you need the best technology regardless of origin, Hikvision is fine. Both comply with Indian law.

Which Brand Should You Choose?

Choose CP Plus If:

  • Budget is a priority (₹30,000-60,000 for 4-8 cameras)
  • You need local language support
  • You want Made-in-India products
  • You don't need advanced AI features
  • You're planning a small home/office setup

Choose Hikvision If:

  • Budget allows for premium investment (₹60,000-150,000)
  • You need advanced AI features (facial recognition, etc.)
  • You have a large/complex system requiring professional support
  • You want best-in-class image quality
  • Long-term durability is more important than upfront cost

Our Recommendation (Eye Smart Security Systems)

After installing 2000+ systems across Delhi NCR, here's our honest take:

  • For 80% of Indian customers: CP Plus offers the best value. It's reliable, affordable, and offers sufficient image quality and features.
  • For high-end applications: Hikvision's AI capabilities and superior quality justify the premium.
  • Best strategy: Start with CP Plus. You can always add Hikvision cameras for critical areas later (though mixing brands is not ideal).

Alternative Brands to Consider

  • UNIVIEW: Between CP Plus and Hikvision in price/quality
  • Dahua: Similar to Hikvision, slightly cheaper
  • Turck: Premium India-based brand (higher price)

Conclusion

Both CP Plus and Hikvision are excellent brands. CP Plus wins on value for Indian customers; Hikvision wins on technology and durability. Choose based on your budget and specific needs.
